notes.title: 1 year since the release of Cast Cats
notes.notes:
Kittens, today is a very special day!



It’s been exactly 1 year since the release of Cast Cats!



This is the game into which I poured a piece of my soul, a flow of imagination, and a creative spark. A warm, cozy, and simple little spot-the-difference game designed to bring you comfort and relaxation.

Over the past year, we’ve released several DLCs:

A spooky pack for horror fans

A free Christmas update

Heroes & Villains content

And most recently — the final free DLC “Resort & Paws”, adding 15 brand-new summer beach levels!

That brings the total to 130 levels in the game!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117350/6a9f3310792aa7157358fba5f7a964b8c0eb5a66.png"]



To celebrate the first anniversary, we’re launching a special sale:

60% off the base game

40% off the Horror Show DLC

20% off the Heroes & Villains DLC



We invite you to try our creation and share your thoughts in a review.



And most importantly — thank you to everyone who has supported us since the very beginning! We regularly check your reviews, see your achievements, and follow the community activity. It’s heartwarming to know that people share screenshots, guides, illustrations, or simply ask questions. It means the world to us that Cast Cats has found its players. 💖

Patch 1.0.5 is out now.

notes.title: Engine Version Updated
notes.notes:
We have updated the version of the engine that the game uses.
This should improve the game's performance and optimization.

If you encounter any problems, please let us know in any convenient way, for example, through discussions.
